name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing dreams, but through a fascination with the engineering precision required. After completing his apprenticeship as a machinist, he specialized in high-performance engine components, quickly gaining a reputation for meticulousness and problem-solving. A chance encounter with a former Formula 3 mechanic led him to Andretti Global, where he's become a key figure in the team's engine development program.

Klaus-Dieter approaches his work with a level of dedication that borders on obsession. He's known for spending hours poring over blueprints, identifying potential weaknesses, and devising innovative solutions. His unwavering commitment to perfection ensures that every component he touches meets the highest standards. While he isn't the most outgoing member of the team, his quiet competence and unwavering loyalty make him an invaluable asset. His ability to diagnose and fix even the most complex mechanical issues under pressure is legendary within the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is of average height with a slightly stocky build and focused, intense eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a specific torque wrench that he refuses to let anyone else use.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy he is.
